title: Hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fa3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d6336c'/>

  </defs>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='41' y='76' width='18' height='13' rx='2' fill='#c98a3f'/>

  <line x1='50' y1='79' x2='50' y2='89' stroke='#a86e28' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='79' x2='56' y2='89' stroke='#a86e28' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <!-- ropes -->
  <line x1='43' y1='76' x2='34' y2='62' stroke='#e8b56a' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <line x1='57' y1='76' x2='66' y2='62' stroke='#e8b56a' stroke-width='1.4'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='32' ry='34' fill='url(#balloon)'/>

  <path d='M50 4 C44 20 44 50 46 62 C48 58 49 40 50 4 Z' fill='#ffc2d1' opacity='0.85'/>
  <path d='M50 4 C56 20 56 50 54 62 C52 58 51 40 50 4 Z' fill='#b02a56' opacity='0.6'/>
  <path d='M22 30 C26 20 30 12 34 8' stroke='#ffc2d1' stroke-width='2' fill='none' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- skirt / opening -->
  <path d='M38 62 Q50 68 62 62 Q58 70 50 70 Q42 70 38 62 Z' fill='#b02a56'/>
  <path d='M40 63 Q50 68 60 63' stroke='#ff8fa3' stroke-width='1.5' fill='none'/>
  <!-- shine -->
  <ellipse cx='37' cy='22' rx='7' ry='11' fill='#ffe0e8' opacity='0.45' transform='rotate(-20 37 22)'/>
